title: Add canonical gauge companion frame cross-check
body:
## Summary

Adds an independent, source-bound cross-output audit of the `_gauge_ann` omission identified in PR #3545. For two distinct exact annihilator spaces, the canonical gzip word payload is unchanged, while the producer's actual `export()` changes its gauge frame reference and exact `frames` record. The pinned generator's complete `--check` includes and compares that companion output, so it rejects the mutation accepted by the word-only comparison.

This narrows the interpretation of the existing payload-level finding: the field is omitted from the canonical word, but the inspected complete output bundle retains and checks it separately. No producer change or selected-frontier change is proposed.

## Verification

- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --check-only --package research/canonical-gauge-frame-crosscheck`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/canonical-gauge-frame-crosscheck`

Both pass on CPython 3.12.3. The test imports the SHA256-pinned producer and runs only its exact geometry, frame-record and export code on a small fixture.

## Scope and limits

This is a source-plumbing audit, not a valid full paired-cube instance, p=12 rebuild, selected cold replay, mathematical theorem, or κ claim. PR #3545 receives credit for identifying the omission and the first payload fixture; this package checks the complementary frame-export path. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/canonical-gauge-frame-crosscheck` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/canonical-gauge-frame-crosscheck --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
